cases.name: oracle-player-744-NFL
cases.reading: Sam LaPorta's available picture centers on elite statistical performance within a thin sample of five appearances, yet this is sharply contrasted by reported frustration and a willingness to seek payment elsewhere. The divergence between his high percentile rankings and his expressed dissatisfaction with the team's support creates a meaningful tension, while the limited sample size and lack of broader context leave the overall trajectory and durability of this situation unknown.
review: Does this fulfill the character's purpose? Is its central reading supported? Record material errors separately from awkward wording and processing cost.
